about_the_game: Return to Rainbow Island to revisit its beauty, excitement, and mysteries with the Slime Rancher 2: Original Soundtrack, Vol. 2! Enjoy nearly 4 hours of music across a total of 40 tracks by series composer Harry Mack. It contains all music released after early access began, including the very popular weather-themed music! (Combined with the Slime Rancher 2: Original Soundtrack, that's almost 7 hours straight of easy, Bea-sy listening!) All tracks are available in high-quality .mp3 and .flac formats.
